fusions.name: Draw the Bitterness
fusions.desc: Draws one of your afflictions out of an enemy up to 6 tiles away, which deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Lobbed Purge
fusions.desc: Spits a glob of poison that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that. The target is left [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Taken Into Yourself
fusions.desc: Draws up to 2 poison conditions out of you and your allies and into your shell, and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Nothing Takes Hold
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 25% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it. Your armour rises by 5%.
